room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay on every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.) capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Accidents exempt; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: No optional reduction available; portability/migration credits apply

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles etc.; joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis have 48-month wait

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy

day_care.note: Extensive listed day-care procedures in Annexure C; list is dynamic

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; fixed cap of ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-covered consumables/non-medical items in Annexure A List I

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded; territorial limit is India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to enhanced SI from date of enhancement

grace_period.note: Coverage not available during grace period for renewal; available during grace period for instalment policies

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewal or porting/migration

portability.note: Port to same product of other insurer; apply 45 days before but not earlier than 60 days before renewal

notable_exclusions: Maternity, domiciliary/OPD, overseas treatment, sterility/IVF, gender change, cosmetic surgery, refractive error <7.5D, war, nuclear/bio/chemical
